issues.justification: The running gag is Lyolik's deliberate mangling of the surname into 'goat-milker' (козёл). The English keeps the near-identical spellings with no equivalent pun, so the insult and Gesha's indignation are lost.

issues.source_quote: за чужой счёт пьют даже трезвенники и язвенники
issues.translation_quote: on someone else's tab, even teetotalers drink and ulcer sufferers
issues.justification: The sentence is garbled: 'drink and ulcer sufferers' reads as if teetotalers drink ulcer sufferers. It should be 'even teetotalers and ulcer sufferers drink'. The boss's aphorism loses its punch.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Whoever buys a whole stack will get... A water tank!
issues.justification: The rhyming lottery slogan, a comic Soviet jingle, is rendered as flat prose. There is no rhyme, and 'water tank' misrepresents the 'водокачка' (water pump station) prize.

issues.source_quote: Семён Семёнович, ну давайте без самодеятельности!
issues.translation_quote: Semyon Semyonovich, come on, no amateur theatricals!
issues.justification: Here 'самодеятельность' means acting on one's own initiative or improvising, not amateur theatre. The earlier line about amateur performance is a different usage, so this mistranslation creates a false echo.
The distorted echo of 'Осторожно' is rendered as an unnatural nonsense word that doesn't read as a plausible foreign-accent joke.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! May I see you in a coffin, in white slippers!
issues.justification: The neighbor's colorful, ungrammatical Odessa-style curse voice is flattened into standard English. The dialect marking is missing, so the comic character voice is lost.
The reference to the one-eyed field marshal (Lyolik has just been hit in the eye) is left untranslated and unexplained, so English viewers miss the joke.
The deliberate mispronunciation 'пыхта' is inconsistent ('furr tree' and then the correct 'fir tree'), and the vulgar pun in 'Жо' is lost with 'W'.

issues.source_quote: Как же я раньше не догадалась?
issues.justification: Ungrammatical and unnatural in English; it should be 'Why didn't I guess sooner?' or 'How could I not have guessed?'
The coinage is creative, but it severs the link to the character name Трынкин ('Volodka Trynkin') and the idiom's folkloric flavor, so a wordplay layer is lost.

issues.source_quote: Не взял попутных - это не таксист!
issues.translation_quote: Won't pick up riders - he's no cabbie!
issues.justification: 'Riders' is odd for hitchhikers or other fares along the route, and the clipped phrasing is awkward.
